title: jstack feature manifest
description: features/<name>/feature.json: what a feature ships beyond its SKILL.md files. scripts/generate-jstack-trees.py reads it, and writes skills.json, the generated regions of pyproject.toml and the docs indexes from it. A path is relative to the feature's folder, or, while the file has not moved there, to the repo root.

description.description: One sentence: what the feature does.

packages.description: Each Python package of the wheel, as src/<package>.

commands.description: Each command on PATH, and the function it runs: [project.scripts].

units.description: Each systemd user unit the install links.

hooks.description: Each harness hook the install adds.

statusLine.description: The status line the install sets, unless the user has one of their own.

gitHooks.description: Each git hook the install puts in a main checkout.

projectSkills.description: Each folder of the feature that holds a skill of this repo's own, which the install links into a checkout's .claude/skills/<name> and .cursor/skills/<name>, by the name its SKILL.md gives.

docs.description: Each page of the feature; the first is the one the README links.

everyRun.description: Each test that runs on every change, whatever the change touches.

needs.description: Each Needs: line of the feature's page of the verify skill.

nameable.description: Each playbook of the feature that a brief's Skills: line may name.

upstream.description: Each file taken from pstack, and how.
